services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: From skiing, to fishing, to cruising and swimming, we have Table Rock Lake boat rentals available for a great day on the Lake. Join us at Hideaway Marina! All watercraft rentals include life jackets for every person on board. For tubes, skis, and boards add $30 to the boat rental. It’s $40 to rent tubes, skis, or boards without a boat rental. Must be 21 to rent a boat. Driver(s) must be born before 1/1/1984 or show proof of Boater’s Safety Certificate. Operating Hours:We only have fuel available during the off season, but we do have boat rentals at our sister marina, Cape Fair

blurb: Hideaway Marina is located on the James River Arm of Table Rock Lake in Galena, Missouri. They offer boat rentals including ski boats, fishing boats, pontoon boats, paddleboards, tubes, and skis. The marina also provides covered slips, a ship store with food, fuel, tackle, and bait, and a pizza restaurant on site.
